idea-plugin.name: MRZ & Barcode Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
MRZ & Barcode Inspector — parse and validate KYC documents offline

A tool window for debugging travel-document and driver's-license parsing without hand-computing check digits. Paste a value and get back the parsed fields plus a pass/fail verdict for every check digit — the exact opposite direction of a generator, and the ideal companion to one.

  • MRZ tab — paste a Machine Readable Zone: TD3 (2×44, passports), TD2 (2×36), TD1 (3×30, ID cards), a machine-readable visa MRV-A (2×44) / MRV-B (2×36), or the pre-2021 French national identity card (2×36, its own field order). Parses document type, names, dates, nationality and validates every individual check digit (document number, date of birth, expiry, personal number) plus the composite check digit — using the same ICAO 7-3-1 routine already covered by Kassi Test Data's DE ID card generator.
  • Barcode tab — paste the decoded text payload of an AAMVA-compliant PDF417 barcode (US/Canada driver's license or ID card): header (IIN, AAMVA/jurisdiction version) and every subfile's data elements, or a precise structural error if the payload is malformed.

100% offline and algorithmic. Zero network calls, zero data collection.

More Kassi tools for QA & fintech: Kassi Test Data — generate valid IBANs, cards, BIC/SWIFT, VAT and national IDs; and Checksum & Regex Playground.

Source, issues & docs: github.com/VadimToptunov/kassi-plugins
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.4.0

  • The tool window now shows a distinct stripe icon.

1.3.0

  • The MRZ tab now reads the pre-2021 French national identity card (a non-ICAO 2×36 layout keyed by the IDFRA prefix), validating its document-number, date-of-birth and composite check digits with the ICAO 7-3-1 routine.

1.2.0

  • Machine-readable visas: the MRZ tab now recognizes MRV-A (2×44) and MRV-B (2×36) visa documents (type V), validating every per-field check digit. Visas carry no composite check digit, per ICAO 9303 Part 7.

1.1.0

  • When a check digit is wrong, the MRZ tab now shows the expected digit (e.g. check digit '5' — expected '6') so you can fix the MRZ, not just see that it's broken.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: MRZ tab (TD1/TD2/TD3, per-field + composite check digits) and Barcode tab (AAMVA PDF417 payload parsing).
  • All parsing/validation logic reuses the shared, tested :engine module.
